hazards.name: Visual Obstruction

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to bring pedestrians past the line of parked cars, improving visibility and shortening crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Amenity Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic and improve the walking experience.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracks and resurface the sidewalk and roadway to improve accessibility and safety for all users.

interventions.title: Roadway Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to better define travel lanes and encourage more predictable vehicle behavior.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised refuge island in the center of the wide street to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Install Bollards or Curbing
interventions.description: Place physical barriers such as bollards or a raised curb to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and to clearly define the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove vegetation growing through the pavement to ensure a smooth, trip-free surface for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically slow traffic to residential speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters in a buffer zone between the sidewalk and the parking lane to narrow the perceived street width and provide a physical barrier.

interventions.title: Green Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or raised crosswalks to ensure low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at the nearest intersection to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk Crossing
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk level across the driveway/alley entrance to force vehicles to slow down and reinforce pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Adding a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and sidewalk would provide a buffer from traffic and a designated space for trash bins.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearance
interventions.description: Enforce clear path requirements to ensure that the full width of the sidewalk remains accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming / Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implementing curb extensions at the nearest intersection would shorten crossing distances and slow turning vehicles in this residential area.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Trim back overhanging bushes and shrubs to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is clear and accessible.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines or edge lines to narrow the perceived travel lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Installing curb extensions at potential crossing points would increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the crossing distance across the roadway.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implementing vertical traffic calming would help maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracks and remove vegetation to ensure a smooth, hazard-free walking surface.

interventions.title: Curb-side Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to increase separation from traffic and improve the walking experience.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: If space permits, introduce a small planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Marking
interventions.description: Narrow the driveway apron and use high-visibility markings or different pavement textures to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way across the vehicle access point.

interventions.title: Street Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or grass buffer between the curb and the sidewalk to increase physical and psychological separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Maintenance
interventions.description: Straighten or replace the leaning utility pole to ensure structural stability.

interventions.title: Roadway resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and smooth the asphalt surface to eliminate trip hazards and improve overall street quality.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and security for people walking at night.

interventions.title: Install Vertical Curbs
interventions.description: Construct raised vertical curbs to better define the roadway edge and prevent vehicles from encroaching onto the grass buffer.
